news.body: Analysts have maintained their fair value estimate for SAMHI Hotels at ₹258.4 per share, with a slightly lower discount rate and a marginally adjusted future P/E assumption supporting the rationale for the updated price target. news.title: SAMHI Hotels Limited (NSEI:SAMHI) agreed to acquire 49% stake in Clean Max Solomon Private Limited for INR 14.6 million.
news.body:
SAMHI Hotels Limited (NSEI:SAMHI) agreed to acquire 49% stake in Clean Max Solomon Private Limited for INR 14.6 million on April 15, 2026. A cash consideration will be paid by SAMHI Hotels Limited.

The deal is expected to be completed on May 15, 2026.

news.title: Investor sentiment improves as stock rises 15%
news.body: After last week's 15% share price gain to ₹148, the stock trades at a forward P/E ratio of 14x. Average forward P/E is 30x in the Hospitality industry in India. Total returns to shareholders of 4.6% over the past year. Simply Wall St's valuation model estimates the intrinsic value at ₹85.41 per share.

news.title: Consensus EPS estimates fall by 12%, revenue upgraded
news.body: The consensus outlook for fiscal year 2026 has been updated. 2026 revenue forecast increased from ₹12.6b to ₹12.7b. EPS estimate fell from ₹8.47 to ₹7.44 per share. Net income forecast to grow 16% next year vs 39% growth forecast for Hospitality industry in India. Consensus price target down from ₹289 to ₹266. Share price fell 2.5% to ₹172 over the past week.

news.title: Price target decreased by 7.7% to ₹266
news.body: Down from ₹289, the current price target is an average from 7 analysts. New target price is 57% above last closing price of ₹169. Stock is down 3.8% over the past year. The company is forecast to post earnings per share of ₹7.13 for next year compared to ₹3.88 last year.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: Revenues exceed analysts expectations while EPS lags behind
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹2.18 (up from ₹1.04 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹3.42b (up 16% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹396.1m (up 74% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 12% (up from 7.7% in 3Q 2025). Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 4.0%. Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates by 39%. Revenue is forecast to grow 13% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 22% growth forecast for the Hospitality industry in India.
